_comment: Where the app's server may open a network connection (PiersAG/app-business-core#756, Matt Murphy #13 and #95: 'services without an internet requirement should have no outbound access'; 'network egress controls'). lib/egress.ts refuses every other host on a deployed instance. Hosts are matched exactly; `suffixes` match the host itself or any name under it. The app's own addresses, the database addresses and the rate-limit store are added from the environment. An app that needs another service adds it here, with the reason, or names it in EGRESS_ALLOW.

hosts.api.turso.tech: Turso platform API: create a tenant's database and mint its tokens (lib/tenant/provisioner.ts)
hosts.secretsmanager.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com: The factory vault: reading a key moved into it (lib/vault.ts)
hosts.sts.amazonaws.com: AWS sign-in for the vault read (lib/vault.ts, Vercel OIDC)
hosts.sts.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com: AWS sign-in for the vault read, regional address

suffixes.turso.io: Tenant and catalog databases (each database has its own name under turso.io)
